analysis: The only change in this PR is documentation in docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines ~2492-2512), adding a Flint constrained-chaining and fused-kernel description. The supplied units are BASE text, lines 1611-2365 (tail of the file up to the Flint section), and the patch adds no lines inside that range. No code, configuration, keys, cache storage, attestation, authorization or wire-protocol behavior changes. The added prose says the Flint constraint now opts into CBv2 constrained chaining, with a maskCacheKey keyed by constraint state and a cached device mask. It says the token stream is identical to unchanged decode, and that the catalog artifact RecursiveSI/flint-int4 joins the automatic paged list at legacy serving width on M5 Pro/Max/Ultra, with fused decode kernels. Relevant threat IDs (T-041 prefix cache, T-028 residual GPU data, TB-007) are not altered by this text. The doc covers only the constraint mask cache, which depends on state and not on prompt content, so it does not touch the encrypted SSD prefix-cache identity, the HMAC lookup tags, the TTL or the scoping. I could not verify the underlying code changes (chaining, mask cache, fused kernels, automatic paged list), because they are outside the supplied evidence. One remaining integration question for the code PR: the cached device masks and the retained logits and RNG state used for the redraw must not carry data across requests or tenants. That follows from the documented per-row retention, but is unverifiable here. No documentation-induced security regression is identified.
